notes:
REF-BM-02: Collects title and description only; favicon and preview image are not fetched.
REF-BM-03: No pre-save editing, and the UI only exposes title/description editing for failed metadata fetches.
REF-BM-04: URL editing is unsupported, while title/description editing is restricted in the UI.
REF-BM-07: Cards expose the textual fields and tags but use generated initials instead of real favicons.
REF-BM-14: Search does not interpret #tag syntax.
REF-BM-15: Boolean operators and parenthesised expressions are not parsed.
REF-BM-16: Quoted exact-phrase search is not implemented.
REF-BM-20: There is no multi-selection or bulk-action facility.
REF-BM-21: There is no whole-filtered-collection bulk action.
REF-BM-22: Results are always newest-first; no selectable sort key is provided.
REF-BM-23: Notes can be written and displayed, but Markdown is rendered as plain text.
REF-BM-24: Local HTML/PDF snapshots are not stored.
REF-BM-25: Internet Archive snapshot creation is not implemented.
REF-BM-26: Bookmark archiving is not implemented.
REF-BM-27: Delete is permanent, but no reversible archive state exists to distinguish from it.
REF-BM-28: There is no archived-bookmarks view.
REF-BM-29: Saved filter bundles are not implemented.
REF-BM-30: Netscape HTML import is not implemented.
REF-BM-31: Netscape HTML export is not implemented.
REF-BM-32: Display-related personal settings are not implemented.
